name: Interreg Spain-Portugal (POCTEP) 2021-2027: Priority 4 biodiversity calls
summary: Cross-border Spain-Portugal calls co-financed by the ERDF. The open 10th call spans priorities 1, 2, 3, 4, 5 and 7; only Priority 4 (objective 2.7) funds nature protection, biodiversity and green infrastructure. Projects have a lead beneficiary and cross-border partners.
